enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Shift legs. Breathe deeply. Turn onto back. Place hand on chest. Remain still. Turn to left side again. Adjust blanket. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out breakfast items. Close refrigerator. Turn on induction cooker. Cook breakfast. Turn off induction cooker. Eat breakfast. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour water into cup. Make coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in work clothes and checking phone for shift messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Take off pajamas. Put on work clothes. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read shift messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Check mirror.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Greet colleague. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care and clinical assessments
enriched_activities.desc: Receive handover. Check patient list. Wash hands. Visit patient 1. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Assess pain level. Administer medication. Document in chart. Visit patient 2. Change wound dressing. Assist with mobility. Visit patient 3. Perform clinical assessment. Update care plan. Communicate with doctor. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break in the staff room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff room. Open locker. Take out lunch bag. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Throw away trash. Return lunch bag to locker. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties, medication rounds and patient documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Check medication chart. Prepare medication. Administer medication to patient 1. Record time. Administer medication to patient 2. Record time. Administer medication to patient 3. Record time. Update patient records. Enter nursing notes. Review lab results. Consult with physician. Assist patient with walking. Monitor vital signs. Document changes. Respond to call bell. Wash hands.
Change out of scrubs. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Remove shoes. Hang up coat.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir fry. Turn off induction cooker. Plate dinner. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and changing into casual clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on water heater. Undress. Step into shower. Turn on water. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off water. Dry with towel. Put on casual clothes. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select news. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch movie. Pause TV. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Resume TV. Watch more. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for continuing education and reviewing clinical notes
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open browser. Navigate to course. Watch lecture. Take notes. Pause lecture. Open clinical notes. Review notes. Highlight key points. Close clinical notes. Resume lecture. Finish lecture. Close browser. Shut down computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the dishwasher, tidying up and having a light snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open dishwasher. Load dirty dishes. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start. Wipe counter. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Eat snack. Throw away trash. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and evening hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with the desk lamp on and sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Change into pajamas. Lie on bed. Pick up book. Read book. Put down book. Turn off desk lamp. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still. Sleep.
